## Karşı Delil ve Sınırlar

- İḍâfe grameri iki ismi zorunlu olarak ilişkilendirir; sahiplik, uygunluk, nedensellik ve tahsis seçeneklerinden birini tek başına seçmez. "Ceza payı" okuması `root_000934/B004`, `root_000013/B003`, odak izleri ve okuyucu yürüyüşleriyle etkinleşen bir sentezdir.
- `root_000934/B005`, `B007`, `B008`, `B010` ve `B012` yerel `طَعَامُ` sözcüğünün sözlük karşılığı olarak sunulmadı. Prosedeki somut "yiyecek" anlamını taşıyan ikincil basınçlar olarak tutuldu.
- `outlier_grafted_body` ile `outlier_consumer_as_cooking_vessel` çapraz-alan benzetmeleridir. HFT'nin kendi containment notları bunların âyetin lexical tanımı yapılmamasını gerektirir.
- HFT, ceza payı için düz ilişki/aidiyet; olgunlaşma için yalın botanik kaynak; iç fırın için şiddet benzetmesi; boğaz tersine dönüşü için ayrı cezalar seçeneklerini canlı karşı-okumalar olarak korur. Prose bu seçenekleri hükümsüzleştirmez.
- Kanal malzemesi ilk geçiş, tek okuyucu incelemesidir; kabul edilmiş kanal defteri ve olgunluk hesabı değildir. Prose yalnız 44:43 ve 44:45'in yerel yüzeylerini kullandı, surah çapında kanal veya tekrar iddiası kurmadı.

## Karşı Kanıt ve Sınırlar

- `v12_cross_run_publication.findings[grade=reject]`, belirlenmiş vaktin dolmasını doğrudan “birikmiş sakin ertelemenin kaynayan aciliyete dönüşmesi” diye kuran geniş sentezi reddeder. Prose bu yüzden `م ه ل` süre dalını yerel ve ikincil bir basınç olarak tutar; belirlenmiş vakit üzerinden zorunlu bir mekanizma kurmaz.
- `v12_focus_trace_hermetic.readers.reader_hft_a.summary.remaining_uncertainties`, süre dalının yüzeydeki madde adına biçimce uzak olduğunu ve astar, gebelik ve toplumsal beden okumalarının analojik kaldığını kaydeder. Bu okumaların tamamı prose içinde anatomik karın ve kaynayan mühl hükmünün içinde tutulmuştur.
- Aynı Focus Trace, örtük öznenin çözümünün yiyecek-etkinliği okumasının gücünü etkilediğini kaydeder. `تَغْلِى` varyantı bu nedenle özne baskısı olarak verildi, yeni bir yerel anlam gibi sunulmadı.
- `inter_ayah_rows[ref=57:3]` “no value” etiketlidir. `44:45:5:inward-outward-contrast` aday konusu prose ve bulgular dizinine alınmadı.

# Karşı Kanıt ve Sınırlar

- `root_001416/B001` için “basınçla sonucu ortaya çıkarma” okuması regular walk, wide walk ve Hermetic trace içinde canlıdır; `v12_cross_run_publication.findings[1]` bunu `reject` olarak işaretler. Prose bu yüzden dalı fiilin yerel anlamı veya bağımsız sonuç okuması olarak sunmaz, yalnız kuşku-çekişme anlamını içeren maddi benzetme olarak taşır.
- HFT `delta_distributed_yield_network`, aynı `root_001416/B001` görüntüsünü farklı âyetlerdeki uzak sözlük dallarının recurrence iddiasına dönüştürür. Yerel payoff `baseline_pressure_draws_out_result` içinde zaten taşındığı, cross-run grade `reject` bulunduğu ve recurrence Layer 2 channel sınırını aştığı için bu delta ayrı reading olarak prose/indexe alınmadı.
- `root_001416/B002`, `root_001332/B003`, `root_001332/B005` ve `root_001456/*` yerel QAC çözümlemesinin seçtiği anlamlar değildir. Prose bunları yüzey kelimeye bağlı, birincil anlamı koruyan ve açıkça benzetme ya da ikincil baskı olarak sınırlandırılmış okumalar hâlinde verir.
- HFT bağlam deltalarının her birinde canlı alternatifler kayıtlıdır. Prose bunları doğruluk sırasına koymaz ve yerel gramerin yerine geçirmez.

# Counter-Evidence And Containment

- `[bundle-traceable]` HFT leaves open whether doubt/security is a causal movement or two parallel contrasts. The prose says “olarak da duyurur,” preserving the physical residence.
- `[bundle-traceable]` HFT leaves open whether messenger, believing, station, and occupants form a deliberate trust trajectory or independent uses. The prose presents a contextual transformation, not authorial intent.
- `[bundle-traceable]` The earlier rescue may be a historical analogy rather than the definition of the later station. The prose calls it a movement line and keeps `B006` as the local sense.
- `[bundle-traceable]` The noble and secure stations may simply contrast condemned and rewarded occupants. The prose limits the gain to what the changed adjective makes visible.
- `[bundle-traceable]` Resurrection standing may be contextual activation rather than the direct local sense of `مَقَامٍ`. The prose explicitly retains residence as the floor.
- `[bundle-traceable]` The punishment geometry may be a broad reward/punishment contrast rather than a point-for-point design. The synthesis is marked `[inference]`.
- `[bundle-traceable]` Gardens, garments, facing, and calling may be independent pleasures. Their nested-protection and openness relations are marked `[inference]`.
- `[bundle-traceable]` The duration facet of `مَقَامٍ` may activate only through 44:56; permanence is therefore contextual, not inserted into the local gloss.
- `[bundle-traceable]` Personifying the station as a trustworthy custodian is uncertain. The prose labels the move as metaphor.
- `[bundle-traceable]` All three HFT outliers are branch-distant. Assay, guarded gait, and watch station are each contained as analogy or possibility and never used as lexical translations.

# Karşı Kanıt ve Sınırlar

- `root_000369/B003` (arıtılmış yardımcı) Hermetik iz ve geniş okuyucu yürüyüşü tarafından aday gösterilmiştir; çapraz koşu yayını yardımcı bulgusunu `reject` olarak işaretler. Bu nedenle karşı kanıt olarak burada korunur ve yerel eş anlamı şeklinde metne girmez.
- `root_000369/B005`, düzenli yürüyüşte eşleştirmeyi 44:15’teki dönüşle karşılaştırmak için kullanılmıştır; çapraz koşu yayını bu özel tersine çevirme iddiasını reddeder. Metin yalnız değişim ile özdeş mevcudiyeti birleştiren ayrı `d04_irreversible_restored_presence` kullanımını taşır ve onu çıkarım olarak işaretler.
- `root_001069/B006` ikincil pınar yankısı olarak kalır. QAC uyumu ve `root_001069/B016`, yerel betimleyici olarak “geniş ve güzel gözlü” anlamını korur.
- `o02_protected_counter_gaze` ve `o03_realized_settlement` dala uzak, düzdeğişmeceli benzetmelerdir. Metin bunların sınırlandırılmış kazanımlarını söyler ve birincil okumayı cehennemin gerçek bir göz sayılması, ödeme ve mülk iddialarından korur.
- `d05_visibility_after_covering`, tam mekanizması bu âyeti kendi başına açıklamak için gerekli olmayan sûre mimarisi taşıdığı için metne alınmamıştır.
- İlk geçiş kanal incelemesi yalnız yerel karşılıklı hizalanmayı desteklemek için kullanılmıştır. Kanal adı, tekrar iddiası, olgunluk iddiası ve sûre tezi metne girmez.
- Ana `حُورٍ` biçimi belirleyici kalır. Okuyuş gözlemleri yalnız betimleyiciliği ve duyusal alanı aydınlatır.

## Karşı Kanıt ve Sınırlar

- Yerel `يَذُوقُونَ` etkin çatılıdır. Edilgen `يُذَاقُونَ` kıraat varyantı eyleyen ve maruz kalan ayrımını gösterir; yerel fiil çözümlemesinin yerine geçirilmedi.
- `ٱلْمَوْتَ` bir isim ve doğrudan nesnedir. Öldürme/ettirgenlik dalı yalnız biçim sınırını açıklamak için tutuldu.
- `ٱلْأُولَىٰ` için baskın eşleme başlangıç ve önceliktir. `root_001684/B002` kesintisiz ardışıklık, bölünmüş ve biçimce uzak bir hedef olduğundan yalnız içerilmiş ikincil baskı olarak kullanıldı.
- `عَذَابَ` yerel olarak ağır ceza adıdır ve `ٱلْجَحِيمِ` ile tamlama kurar. Tatlı su, tüketmeme ve alıkoyma dalları yerel sözlük karşılığı yapılmadı.
- `ٱلْجَحِيمِ` yerel olarak kızgın ateş alanıdır. Göz/bakış dalındaki `o_hostile_gaze_reversed` görsel çağrışımı, yerel getirisi ateş ve koruma açıklamasını tekrar ettiği ve dal mesafesi yüksek olduğu için ana metne alınmadı.
- Yay sınama ve ölümcül gerilim sentezi `o_no_lethal_overdraw`, 44:24'teki ikinci köke bağımlı ve yerel tatma anlamından uzak olduğu için ana metne alınmadı.
- Formül, okuyucu yürüyüşü ve HFT bağları bağlamla etkinleşen okumalar olarak `[inference]` işaretlendi; bunlar yerel gramerin yerine konmadı.

# s044 Semantic Channel Discovery

## Parent Channels

### 1. P1 (44:1-16) - Ordered Revelation as a Document Workflow
- Semantic invariant: Authoritative content is assembled into a record, discriminated into determinate units, and dispatched from its source.
- Surface relation: direct; 44:2 `كِتَابِ/مُبِينِ`, 44:3 `أَنزَلْ`, 44:4 `يُفْرَقُ/أَمْرٍ/حَكِيمٍ`, and 44:5 `أَمْرًا/عِندِ/مُرْسِلِينَ`.
- Surprising reach: The sequence joins writing's binding operation to decision's separating operation: what is first stitched into an intelligible whole is then sorted, ratified, placed, and released like an administrative dispatch.

#### Subchannel A. A bound record made legible
- Reading type: mixed
- Scene or process: Separate pieces are joined and inscribed as a binding record whose contents are exposed through verbal or graphic signs.
- Active motifs: joining or stitching parts (`quranic:root_001283:B001/m01`); written record (`quranic:root_001283:B002/m01`); binding decree (`quranic:root_001283:B003/m01`); emergence into clarity (`quranic:root_000170:B004/m01`); disclosure by speech, writing, or sign (`quranic:root_000170:B005/m01`).
- Ayah anchors: 44:2 `كِتَابِ` (ك ت ب), `مُبِينِ` (ب ي ن).
- Synthesis: Writing is not only inscription but the joining and fastening of parts. The manifest book therefore appears as a constructed record whose binding force and visible articulation make an authoritative whole available to be read.

#### Subchannel B. Matters sorted and ratified
- Reading type: mixed
- Scene or process: A complete field of affairs is separated into distinguishable cases, deliberated, judged, and made precise.
- Active motifs: discrimination between things (`quranic:root_001148:B001/m01`); distribution into parts (`quranic:root_001148:B002/m01`); affairs or cases (`quranic:root_000051:B001/m01`); binding command (`quranic:root_000051:B002/m01`); deliberation and settled resolve (`quranic:root_000051:B007/m01`); adjudication (`quranic:root_000348:B002/m01`); sound judgment (`quranic:root_000348:B003/m01`); precise construction (`quranic:root_000348:B004/m01`); encompassing whole (`quranic:root_001315:B003/m01`).
- Ayah anchors: 44:4 `يُفْرَقُ` (ف ر ق), `كُلُّ` (ك ل ل), `أَمْرٍ` (ء م ر), `حَكِيمٍ` (ح ك م); 44:5 `أَمْرًا` (ء م ر).
- Synthesis: The wise affair is a decision mechanism rather than an undifferentiated topic. It divides a total field into cases, applies deliberative and judicial intelligence, and leaves each portion in a precise, binding form.

#### Subchannel C. Placed and dispatched from the source
- Reading type: mixed
- Scene or process: The ratified content is put in its proper rank, sent downward, and released through a message-bearing envoy from a proximate source.
- Active motifs: sending something down (`quranic:root_001492:B002/m01`); placing a thing in its proper station (`quranic:root_001492:B004/m01`); release and dispatch (`quranic:root_000563:B001/m01`); envoy and carried message (`quranic:root_000563:B002/m01`); nearness and presence at the source (`quranic:root_001052:B004/m01`).
- Ayah anchors: 44:3 `أَنزَلْ` (ن ز ل); 44:5 `عِندِ` (ع ن د), `مُرْسِلِينَ` (ر س ل).
- Synthesis: The decree moves as a controlled transmission: it is assigned a station, sent from a present source, and released through the same lexical machinery that carries both an envoy and the envoy's message.

### 2. P1 (44:1-16) - Generative Custody of Life
- Semantic invariant: Legitimate lordship originates, shelters, develops, preserves, and can withdraw animate force.
- Surface relation: direct; 44:6 `رَحْمَةً/رَبِّ`, 44:7 `رَبِّ`, and 44:8 `يُحْىِ/يُمِيتُ/رَبُّ/ءَابَائِ/أَوَّلِينَ`.
- Surprising reach: Mercy's womb, the parent's formative care, rain-fed animation, and the removal of force materialize lordship as an intimate ecology of generation rather than title alone.

#### Subchannel A. Nurture within generative shelter
- Reading type: latent/lexical
- Scene or process: An owner-caretaker repairs and develops life within a merciful, womb-like shelter continuous with parental causation.
- Active motifs: ownership and lordship (`quranic:root_000532:B001/m01`); gradual repair and nurture (`quranic:root_000532:B002/m01`); merciful tenderness (`quranic:root_000552:B001/m01`); womb as generative enclosure (`quranic:root_000552:B003/m01`); fatherhood, upbringing, and generative causation (`quranic:root_000007:B001/m01`).
- Ayah anchors: 44:6 `رَحْمَةً` (ر ح م), `رَبِّ` (ر ب ب); 44:7 `رَبِّ` (ر ب ب); 44:8 `رَبُّ/رَبُّ` (ر ب ب), `ءَابَائِ` (ء ب و).
- Synthesis: The cluster gives custody a bodily and domestic mechanism. Rule becomes sustained repair and upbringing, while mercy supplies the enclosing womb in which life can be brought forth and maintained.

#### Subchannel B. Animation between rainfall and cessation
- Reading type: mixed
- Scene or process: Life rises through rain, vegetation, and animate force, is preserved from killing, and ends when that force is withdrawn.
- Active motifs: earth enlivened by rain and vegetation (`quranic:root_000383:B002/m01`); animate life (`quranic:root_000383:B003/m01`); preservation from killing (`quranic:root_000383:B006/m01`); loss of life and force (`quranic:root_001454:B001/m01`); removal or weakening of force (`quranic:root_001454:B002/m01`); first beginning (`quranic:root_000067:B001/m01`).
- Ayah anchors: 44:8 `يُحْىِ` (ح ي ي), `يُمِيتُ` (م و ت), `أَوَّلِينَ` (ء و ل).
- Synthesis: Giving life expands into the revival of land and the preservation of living beings; causing death is its exact reversal, the withdrawal of force. The reference to firstness fixes both operations within an originating life cycle.

### 3. P1 (44:1-16) - An Observed Cycle of Affliction
- Semantic invariant: A warned-of pressure approaches, covers its subjects, briefly recedes, and returns in a more decisive form.
- Surface relation: direct; 44:3 `مُنذِرِينَ`, 44:10 `ٱرْتَقِبْ/تَأْتِى/دُخَانٍ`, 44:11 `يَغْشَى/عَذَابٌ/أَلِيمٌ`, 44:12 and 44:15 `كَشْف/عَذَاب`, and 44:16 `نَبْطِشُ/بَطْشَةَ/كُبْرَى/مُنتَقِمُونَ`.
- Surprising reach: The same event is rendered as a sentinel's sighting, an atmospheric shroud, a clinical remission and relapse, and finally the grip of a hand.

#### Subchannel A. A lookout sees the shroud approach
- Reading type: mixed
- Scene or process: Advance warning places a watcher at a lookout as a dark, oppressive event moves in across the overhead field.
- Active motifs: alarm that activates caution (`quranic:root_001488:B001/m01`); watchful waiting (`quranic:root_000584:B001/m01`); guarding and surveillance (`quranic:root_000584:B002/m01`); elevated lookout (`quranic:root_000584:B003/m01`); arrival (`quranic:root_000009:B001/m01`); arriving calamity or hostile overhang (`quranic:root_000009:B011/m01`); severe event (`quranic:root_001700:B003/m01`); smoke rising from combustion (`quranic:root_000465:B001/m01`); black turbidity (`quranic:root_000465:B003/m01`); oppressive smoky day (`quranic:root_000465:B007/m01`); overhead sky or cloud (`quranic:root_000745:B004/m01`).
- Ayah anchors: 44:3 `مُنذِرِينَ` (ن ذ ر); 44:10 `ٱرْتَقِبْ` (ر ق ب), `يَوْمَ` (ي و م), `تَأْتِى` (ء ت ي), `سَّمَاءُ` (س م و), `دُخَانٍ` (د خ ن).
- Synthesis: Warning creates a sentinel scene before the affliction becomes bodily. From a lexical watchtower, the observer sees an event advancing under the sky as rising smoke, black murk, and an atmosphere of heat and constriction.

#### Subchannel B. A blanket that occludes and hurts
- Reading type: surface-primary
- Scene or process: A generalized covering settles over people and converts atmospheric occlusion into inflicted pain.
- Active motifs: covering that hides what lies beneath (`quranic:root_001088:B001/m01`); calamity that envelops a population (`quranic:root_001088:B002/m01`); punitive pain (`quranic:root_000994:B005/m01`); felt pain (`quranic:root_000046:B001/m01`); infliction of pain (`quranic:root_000046:B002/m01`).
- Ayah anchors: 44:11 `يَغْشَى` (غ ش و), `عَذَابٌ` (ع ذ ب), `أَلِيمٌ` (ء ل م).
- Synthesis: The smoke does not merely obscure vision. Its covering function becomes a population-wide seizure of the body, joining the enveloping event to both the experience and deliberate infliction of pain.

#### Subchannel C. Cover lifted, condition resumed
- Reading type: mixed
- Scene or process: The covering and distress are removed for a slight interval, but the subjects resume a recurrent condition like a returning fever or ingrained habit.
- Active motifs: lifting a cover or distress (`quranic:root_001302:B001/m01`); exposing what had been hidden (`quranic:root_001302:B002/m01`); punitive pain (`quranic:root_000994:B005/m01`); return and fever-like recurrence (`quranic:root_001058:B001/m01`); habituated repetition (`quranic:root_001058:B004/m01`); slight amount or interval (`quranic:root_001251:B001/m01`).
- Ayah anchors: 44:12 `ٱكْشِفْ` (ك ش ف), `عَذَابَ` (ع ذ ب); 44:15 `كَاشِفُوا` (ك ش ف), `عَذَابِ` (ع ذ ب), `قَلِيلًا` (ق ل ل), `عَائِدُونَ` (ع و د).
- Synthesis: Relief behaves as temporary exposure rather than cure. Once the cover is raised, the underlying disposition returns with the regularity of recurrent illness and the force of an acquired habit.

#### Subchannel D. The cycle closes as a punitive grasp
- Reading type: surface-primary
- Scene or process: Recurrence culminates in a violent taking whose magnitude and retaliatory purpose remove the earlier interval of relief.
- Active motifs: violent seizure (`quranic:root_000126:B001/m01`); great magnitude (`quranic:root_001281:B001/m01`); burdensome severity (`quranic:root_001281:B010/m01`); rejection and grievance (`quranic:root_001545:B001/m01`); retaliatory punishment (`quranic:root_001545:B002/m01`); severe event (`quranic:root_001700:B003/m01`).
- Ayah anchors: 44:16 `يَوْمَ` (ي و م), `نَبْطِشُ/بَطْشَةَ` (ب ط ش), `كُبْرَى` (ك ب ر), `مُنتَقِمُونَ` (ن ق م).
- Synthesis: What first arrived as a diffuse shroud contracts into the focused action of a hand. Magnitude is now the weight of the seizure, and grievance becomes its retaliatory outcome.

### 4. P1 (44:1-16) - Reception and Counter-Framing
- Semantic invariant: A message becomes effective through perception, recognition, and recollection, but a resistant receiver can recode disclosure as rumor or derangement.
- Surface relation: direct; 44:6 `سَّمِيعُ/عَلِيمُ`, 44:7 `مُّوقِنِينَ`, 44:13 `ذِّكْرَى/جَاءَ/رَسُولٌ/مُّبِينٌ`, and 44:14 `تَوَلَّ/قَالُ/مُعَلَّمٌ/مَجْنُونٌ`.
- Surprising reach: The communicative chain moves from ear to understanding to identifying mark and memory, then reverses when withdrawal converts a clear message into a circulating false attribution.

#### Subchannel A. A signal heard into marked certainty
- Reading type: latent/lexical
- Scene or process: Sound is received, understood, and obeyed; knowledge recognizes distinguishing marks until uncertainty is displaced.
- Active motifs: auditory reception (`quranic:root_000741:B001/m01`); understanding and compliance (`quranic:root_000741:B003/m01`); knowledge and recognition (`quranic:root_001040:B001/m01`); distinguishing mark or way-sign (`quranic:root_001040:B002/m01`); settled certainty (`quranic:root_001696:B001/m01`).
- Ayah anchors: 44:6 `سَّمِيعُ` (س م ع), `عَلِيمُ` (ع ل م); 44:7 `مُّوقِنِينَ` (ي ق ن).
- Synthesis: Hearing is completed not by acoustic contact but by comprehension and responsive action. Knowledge then reads marks as evidence, producing a certainty that is both perceptual and orienting.

#### Subchannel B. A reminder arrives as explicit message
- Reading type: mixed
- Scene or process: A messenger's arrival restores absent knowledge by making it present in memory and explicit in language.
- Active motifs: recall after absence (`quranic:root_000516:B003/m01`); reminder that causes recollection (`quranic:root_000516:B009/m01`); arrival and presence (`quranic:root_000281:B001/m01`); envoy and carried message (`quranic:root_000563:B002/m01`); emergence into clarity (`quranic:root_000170:B004/m01`); disclosure by language or sign (`quranic:root_000170:B005/m01`).
- Ayah anchors: 44:13 `ذِّكْرَى` (ذ ك ر), `جَاءَ` (ج ي ء), `رَسُولٌ` (ر س ل), `مُّبِينٌ` (ب ي ن).
- Synthesis: The messenger does not supply a novel object alone; arrival reactivates memory. Explicit discourse makes what should be recalled visible again and gives recollection a public carrier.

#### Subchannel C. Withdrawal manufactures a counter-story
- Reading type: mixed
- Scene or process: The receiver turns away, replaces the message with a false attribution, and circulates a diagnosis that figures reason as covered.
- Active motifs: withdrawal and refusal of proximity (`quranic:root_001684:B007/m01`); spoken assertion (`quranic:root_001272:B001/m01`); false attribution of unsaid material (`quranic:root_001272:B005/m01`); circulating public talk (`quranic:root_001272:B007/m01`); learned or taught knowledge (`quranic:root_001040:B001/m02`); reason covered by madness (`quranic:root_000266:B006/m01`); hidden interior mind (`quranic:root_000266:B010/m01`).
- Ayah anchors: 44:14 `تَوَلَّ` (و ل ي), `قَالُ` (ق و ل), `مُعَلَّمٌ` (ع ل م), `مَجْنُونٌ` (ج ن ن).
- Synthesis: Refusal is an active discourse operation. Turning away breaks reception, while speech fabricates and broadcasts a replacement account: teaching is recoded as external scripting and the messenger's inner reason as concealed by madness.

### 5. P2 (44:17-33) - Assay and Legitimate Custody
- Semantic invariant: Trials, marks, trust, and warrants make quality and rightful custody publicly distinguishable.
- Surface relation: direct; 44:17 `فَتَنَا/رَسُولٌ/كَرِيمٌ`, 44:18 `أَدُّ/عِبَادَ/رَسُولٌ/أَمِينٌ`, 44:19 `ءَاتِي/سُلْطَانٍ/مُّبِينٍ`, and 44:32-33 `ٱخْتَرْ/عِلْمٍ/ءَايَاتِ/بَلَاءٌ/مُّبِينٌ`.
- Surprising reach: A political confrontation takes the form of material quality control: the emissary is assayed, entrusted persons are transferred against a warrant, and a community is selected through marked testing.

#### Subchannel A. The emissary as assayed material
- Reading type: mixed
- Scene or process: Fire-like testing separates sound material from dross and discloses an envoy as noble and trustworthy.
